label: early original-phase w/n/q/k/g/s inputs in sequences starting with h/1/m/0/f
explanation: Almost entirely (99% of mass) an original-phase unit, firing at positions t=2..5 (peak at t=3, 48% of mass; never at t=0, rarely at t=1 or t>=6). It responds to the identity of the current input token: w is by far the strongest (9.5x lift, 35% of mass; top activations are almost all w), followed by n, q, k, g, s, and weaker a, l, u. Its firing is strongly gated by the FIRST original token: sequences starting with h, 1, m, 0 (and less so f, z, j) are 3-6x enriched, and this specifically depends on first_tok, not on those tokens appearing anywhere earlier. Activation is mostly on the first occurrence of the token. It is essentially silent in the delimiter and copy phases. The conjunction of position, token set, and first-token set reaches only about F1 0.5 / mass recall 0.7; the leftover looks like a graded additive mix of token and first-token contributions, not a crisp rule.
